units.source_scale_reason: One fixed anatomical scale per original source matches the existing approximately 216px head-to-sole body. Pelvis and planted soles provide registration; no per-pose resizing or deformation.

visual_review.notes: Eight original clips reviewed at source and native scale: articulated bowstring idle, melee shove with coherent recovery, nock/draw/release at frame 5, reciprocal walking, dedicated physical rally, four hit/defense poses and eight grounded death poses. Repainted defense preserves bow-hand ownership; reaction scale corrected to stable 216px anatomy. No painted projectile after release; source bow and quiver retained.
